title: Context memory for coding agents
score_reasons: Grounded memory mechanism for agent continuity.
summary: A local event log stores compact summaries so coding agents avoid repeating failed attempts and can preserve project context across runs.

concepts.name: Context memory
concepts.summary: Persistent project context that records decisions, failed attempts, and compact state for future agent runs.

title: Small replay harness for agent evals
score_reasons: Agent evaluation harness with reproducible replay fixtures.
summary: A fixture-driven eval harness replays frozen inputs and scores agent outputs with deterministic checks before any live judge call.

concepts.name: Replay harness
concepts.summary: Frozen inputs and expected outcomes used to compare active and candidate prompt behavior.
